column3: E7 Activity. The sampling campaign for a painting. Groups its sample takings.
E22 Human-Made Object. The source object. Diminished by sampling but remains the same painting.

E53 Place. The area of the source object the sample was taken from. Needs at least a human-readable description (P3), noting how the site was identified; an image annotation or measured position can be added (not shown).
S2 Sample Taking. Removes the first material record (O5) and, through the nested creation event, creates the sample lineage.
E65 Creation, part of the sample taking (P9). Creates the sample lineage (P94). An E15 can do this instead when a sample is registered retrospectively.

column1: //subgraph The sample lineage and its registration

column3: E15 Identifier Assignment. Gives the sample lineage its IGSN. The IGSN identifies the physical sample; it is recorded on the lineage because that is the only part of the model that lasts for the sample's whole life.
E17 Type Assignment, part of the registration. Sets the first status of the sample.

E89 Propositional Object. The sample lineage: stands for the sample over its full life cycle. Carries the IGSN, the kind of sample and its status, and is about (P129) every material record, past and current. Adding a material record does not change the proposition, which always covered the full life cycle.
E55 Type. Marks an E89 as a sample lineage.
E55 Type. The kind of sample. Does not change over the sample's life.
S13 Sample. Material record: the material as taken from the painting, in Pot 1. Ended by sub-sampling 1a.
S13 Sample. Material record: the material remaining after sub-sampling 1a, still in Pot 1. Ended by sub-sampling 1b.
S13 Sample. Material record: the material remaining after sub-sampling 1b, still in Pot 1.
E55 Type. A format. Fixed for the life of each material record.
E22 Human-Made Object. A container, with its own minted IRI even if it has no label or public identifier. Contains each material record for that record's whole life (O25).
E22 Human-Made Object. A new pot chosen for the material removed in sub-sampling 1a.
E22 Human-Made Object. A new pot chosen for the material removed in sub-sampling 1b.
E22 Human-Made Object. A storage container, for example a slide box. Moving the box (E9, not shown) moves every material record in it without changing them.
E53 Place. Where the containers are kept.

S2 Sample Taking also typed E63 and E64. Same pattern as the first sample taking, with the parent's current material record as the source. Ends S13 1.1, starts the remainder S13 1.2 in the same pot, removes S13 1a.1 into a new pot and creates the child lineage.
E53 Place. Where in the parent material the fragment came from; a description is enough. Required by O4 sampled at.
E65 Creation, part of the sub-sampling. Creates the child lineage.
A second sub-sampling using the same pattern (O4 not shown). Ends S13 1.2, starts S13 1.3 in the same pot, removes S13 1b.1 into a new pot and creates the child lineage.
E89 Propositional Object. The child sample lineage created by sub-sampling 1a, with its own identifier. Linked to its parent only through the material records and the sub-sampling event.
E89 Propositional Object. The child sample lineage created by sub-sampling 1b. Later used up in analysis; the lineage keeps its identifier and results.
S13 Sample. Material record: the material of Sample 1a as removed, in Pot 2. Ended by the change of container.
S13 Sample. The only material record of Sample 1b, in Pot 3. Ended when it is used up.

E7 Activity also typed E63 and E64. Moves Sample 1a from Pot 2 to Box 1 by ending S13 1a.1 (P93) and starting S13 1a.2, which Box 1 contains. Each containment therefore lasts exactly as long as its material record. No E9 for samples.
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1a in Box 1, material and format unchanged. Ended by embedding.

E7 Activity also typed E63 and E64. Ends S13 1a.2 and starts S13 1a.3 with a new format, in the same box. By default the resin is part of the material record and the block is not recorded separately. P125 is used because P126 employed needs an E11 Modification.
E17 Type Assignment, part of the embedding. Sets the format of the new material record.
E57 Material. Used in embedding (P125); part of the material record from then on.
S1 Matter Removal also typed E63 and E64. Diminishes S13 1a.3 (O1), ends it and starts S13 1a.4 in the same box. The format is unchanged.
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1a once embedded, in Box 1. Ended by polishing.
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1a after polishing, in Box 1. Ended when an assessment finds the resin has yellowed.
E55 Type. Effect type: the event ends the current material record and starts a new one in the same lineage, in a container chosen for it (new or current).
E55 Type. Effect type: the new material record gets a new format, set by an E17 inside the event.
E55 Type. Effect type: the event ends the last material record (E64, P93) and sets the lineage status to Consumed.
S27 Observation. Any examination or analysis, attached to the material record that existed at the time. It finds no change, so S13 1a.4 continues.
S4 Single Observation. One per material identified, on the material record that existed at the time.
S9 Property Type. The presence of a material.
E57 Material. An identified material, from a controlled vocabulary.
Images, spectra, data files and reports. Link provisional; full results pattern still open (Q12).
S5 Inference Making. Interpretation of results, at the time or later. Full pattern, for example via CRMinf, still open (Q12).

column1: //subgraph An assessment that finds a change

column3: S27 Observation also typed E63 and E64. Finds that the resin has yellowed since the last record, so it ends S13 1a.4 and starts S13 1a.5 in the same box. The change happened no later than the assessment. An assessment that finds no change leaves the current material record in place.
S4 Single Observation. Records the condition found, on the new material record it describes.
S9 Property Type. The condition of the material, including any resin that is part of it.
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1a with yellowed resin, in Box 1. The current material of Sample 1a.
S27 Observation also typed E64 End of Existence. Observes S13 1b.1 and ends it (P93). No E6: the lineage remains, with status Consumed. Accidental destruction: E64 alone, with status Destroyed.
E17 Type Assignment, part of the analysis. Lineage statuses: Available, Missing, Consumed (used up as planned), Destroyed (accident or damage).

column3: E7 Activity also typed E63 and E64. OPTIONAL pattern. Ends S13 1.3 and starts S13 1.4 on a stub, which is recorded as its container. Used where the support can be separated from the sample.
E22 Human-Made Object. OPTIONAL. A support that can be separated, recorded as a container. As a physical object it can also have its own condition assessed (E14, not shown).
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1 mounted on Stub 1. Ended when the sample is found to be missing from the stub.

E7 Activity also typed E63 and E64. The stub is present but the sample is not on it: ends S13 1.4 and starts S13 1.5 in an unknown container, with status Missing. If the container had been lost with the sample, no new record would start; only the status would change. When found, a new record starts in the real container and the status returns to Available.
E22 Human-Made Object. A placeholder for a container that is not known, so that every material record still has a container.
S13 Sample. Material record: Sample 1 while missing; material and format assumed unchanged.
